#376 fix r3.summary:
#376 round 3 is done. It is one amended commit, 4df1b2bf, rebased onto dfb4ddcc. Nothing was pushed, and the gates and the whole suite are green.

(0) The rebase hit conflicts only in line-number citations. Main's side was kept and the citations were relocated with check_citations --fix.
(1) The model/credential check now runs once, inside AgentHarness.prompt, after the input hook and before the user message is built. It is bound with the new set_prompt_check, and the CLI factory binds turn_refusal. The pre-hook gates in RPC and the TUI are removed. RPC now awaits an on_accept verdict (pi's preflightResult) and still answers before agent_start. As a result: InputHandled works on a keyless setup; a model an input hook switches to is the one judged; send_message(trigger_turn=True) is refused and writes nothing.
(2) The fallback line is now computed after session_start and names the model that is actually active, at launch and after each rebuild.
(3)(4)(7) Guides, ADR-0239 decisions 3/5/6 plus its divergences, the ADR index and CHANGELOG are corrected. They now cover the stricter custom-id case and the getting-started comment.
(5)(6) Added rows for the queue order of an idle pick and for --fork.

Two #367 rows now get the refusal text from the new check, so their assertions were updated.

Commit message: grep -c '^#' prints 0, it ends with the exact trailer, and has a single trailing newline. The throwaway worktrees are removed.
sweep: Every way a prompt starts goes through the one check in AgentHarness.prompt: RPC prompt, the TUI loop, -p and json, and extension send_message(trigger_turn=True). steer and follow_up are queued during a turn, as in pi.
The fallback line is set again after session_start on every build: launch, /new, /resume, /fork, /clone, /import, /reload, and RPC switch_session, fork and clone (through _settle_late_route).
A turn refused by the #367 turn gate (_refused_by) is not asked; its row keeps the #367 behaviour.
RPC harness doubles that lack on_accept are still answered at once (an inspect.signature fallback), so the existing test doubles keep their contract.
owner_decisions: main moved to 8428e16c (#405) during this round. The commit sits on dfb4ddcc as instructed, so it needs a rebase before merge (likely conflicts are citations and the CHANGELOG).

A send_message(trigger_turn=True) on a model that cannot run is now refused and writes nothing, as the decision asked. pi does not check there. A handler that waits for that turn's agent_end is never woken, because no turn starts. This is recorded as a divergence in ADR-0239.
follow_ups: RPC set_model and cycle_model record no model_change. Only embedders are affected today; pi records it.

The TUI's #189 adapter gate, which is older than #376, still answers an unrunnable model before the input hook. Moving it after the hook would need its advice to be rendered from the harness's refusal.
/agents use with a profile that names no model moves a restored session off its model.
Sessions do not record their launch model as a model_change (pi does, at sdk.ts:456).

findings.title: Print/json still reject before extension input handlers run
findings.detail: Category 1. With settings selecting anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5, no credentials, and an extension whose input handler returns InputHandled() for 'ping', print and json modes exit 1 with 'No API key found for Anthropic.' and the handler is never called; RPC succeeds. Codex attributes this to the remaining credential gate at packages/aelix-coding-agent/src/aelix_coding_agent/cli/entry.py:3844, which returns before run_print_mode reaches prompt. Codex treats this as a pre-existing gate, not a regression from the parent.
findings.evidence: argv: -p --session-dir <tmp>/sessions -e <tmp>/handle.py ping. Script: .omc/probes/376-live/r3cross/probes/probe_print_handled.py (uses probe_modes.py). Command: uv run --no-sync python probe_print_handled.py. Output: 'MODE print EXIT 1 INPUT_HANDLER_CALLED False / STDERR No API key found for Anthropic. / MODE json EXIT 1 INPUT_HANDLER_CALLED False / MODE rpc EXIT 0 INPUT_HANDLER_CALLED True'. Full output in probes/print_handled.out

findings.title: Docs and CHANGELOG say handled input needs no key in every mode

findings.evidence: Same probe as finding 1: 'MODE print EXIT 1 INPUT_HANDLER_CALLED False', 'MODE json EXIT 1 INPUT_HANDLER_CALLED False'.

findings.title: Regression: RPC now rejects Vertex prompts that use Application Default Credentials
findings.detail: Category 3. Setup: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=fake-project, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=us-central1, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing to a local fake authorized-user credential, and no GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY. On the parent commit the RPC prompt succeeds. On HEAD it fails with 'No API key found for Google-Vertex.' Codex says the new credential check at core/runnable_models.py:804 does not account for ADC. Pi accepts this configuration (PI_ENV_AUTH <authenticated>). Only the remote SDK client was replaced with a local double.
findings.evidence: argv: --provider google-vertex --model gemini-2.5-flash --mode rpc --session-dir <tmp>/sessions. RPC input: {id:adc,type:prompt,message:hello}. Script: probes/probe_vertex.py. Parent: 'RPC_SUCCESS True ... LOCAL_SDK_CALLS [gemini-2.5-flash] MESSAGES [(user,None),(assistant,stop)]'. Head: 'RPC_SUCCESS False RPC_ERROR No API key found for Google-Vertex. LOCAL_SDK_CALLS [] MESSAGES []'. Pi check: probes/probe_pi_adc.py, which printed 'PI_ENV_AUTH <authenticated> NODE_EXIT 0'.

#376 codex r3.verdicts: 1: counterexample found (print/json reject before input handlers run). 2: false docs found (providers-and-models.md:95 and CHANGELOG.md:322 claim handled input works without a key in every mode). 3: regression from the parent found (Vertex ADC prompts now rejected over RPC). 4: mutant survives (skipping model restore for --resume passes all 227 focused tests); survival across every changed test file is not fully verified.

blocking.title: Fix item 1 is incomplete for -p/json: their launch gate still refuses a keyless model before the input handlers, but the CHANGELOG, guide, ADR-0239 decision 6 and the message say every mode asks after them

InputHandled needs no model') and the commit message. Fix: reduce that gate's credential arm to the harness check, or narrow the text to RPC/TUI and record the -p/json divergence.
